_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in the Anxiety band with offsetting liquidity vs crowded/flat flow signals, so the skilled call is range continuation until a breaker clears.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst firm HOLD/Anxiety; narrative silent on forward phase so no confirmed agreement
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G stays 39-54, funding near flat, BTC rangebound, no ETF-flow impulse
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G <39 with elevated netflow and ETF flows ~0 (down to Denial), or CVD positive + ETF rebound and F&G >55 (up to Disbelief)
